- POC success metric: decrease average tokens per session by 30% w/o visible drop in answer quality; moderation false positive < 3%.
- Competitor note: tried vendor X (simple UI) but rate limits and cost killed it; liked response quality from Y but cost too high.
- Helpful assets: pricing deck + security answers uploaded to Drive (links attached).
- Open questions: EU student data residency for some pilot districts (small subset), timeline for SOC2 evidence, example SLA for moderation throughput.
